test_title: PYST 54: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the portal launched by the Government of India to support gender-responsive planning and budgeting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gender Budgeting Knowledge Hub**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gender Budgeting Knowledge Hub** was established by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)** to serve as a central **resource repository** for all stakeholders involved in **Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB)**.
 
• The portal acts as a digital platform that provides **technical support**, guidelines, and **analytical tools** to various **central ministries**, **state governments**, and **union territories** to facilitate the integration of gender perspectives into the budget cycle.
 
• It contains a comprehensive collection of **training modules**, **research reports**, and **best practices** from across India and the world, aimed at enhancing the **capacity building** of government officials.
 
• The primary function of this hub is to streamline the **monitoring and evaluation** of gender-related expenditures, ensuring that **government schemes** effectively address the specific needs and **socio-economic challenges** faced by women.
